summary: Palmdale School District expresses concerns about the impact of E-Rate cuts on their budget and educational needs. The comment argues that limiting E-Rate to rural or single-provider areas would disproportionately impact high-need students in urban and suburban districts, and urges the FCC to reject any approach that substitutes geography for need. The school district opposes screen-time limits and parental opt-out as unfunded mandates that duplicate local authority and undermine the program's purpose. They argue that these requirements would impose additional costs and administrative burdens on school districts without providing additional benefits.
